title: 教室座位表
question: 老師要印座位表。請輸入有幾排、每排有幾個座位，一排輸出一行，座位寫成「排-號」，中間空一格，例如第 1 排是「1-1 1-2 1-3」。

en.title: Seat Chart
en.question: The teacher prints a seat chart. Input the number of rows and the seats in each row. Output one line for each row. Write each seat as "row-seat" with a space between, like "1-1 1-2 1-3" for row 1.
